tagline: 柯尼卡取景器相机，1989 年发布
description: 柯尼卡于1989年推出的取景器相机。配备34 mm f/5,6 (3 elements/3 groups)。快门速度1–1/200 s. Electronic self-timer.。使用Motor wind and auto rewind.。Fixed focus from 1,1 m to infinity; voice activated mode switches to close focusing (0,9–1,8 m).。

specs.对焦: Fixed focus from 1,1 m to infinity; voice activated mode switches to close focusing (0,9–1,8 m).
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, flash-matic exposure, automatically activated or forced. Can be turned off. Slow synchro up to one second. Range 1,1–3,3 m (ISO 100).
specs.英文简介: Designed as a "party camera", the Konica Kanpai (or Konica Kanpa!), meaning "cheers" in Japanese, reacts to voices and tries to shoot the source of the sound.
